reasoning: The PKGBUILD and .SRCINFO are standard and safe. The source is fetched from GitHub with a pinned SHA256 checksum, and the build uses standard meson/ninja commands. The disagreement was solely due to an API error in the first model.
disagreement_analysis: The qwen model encountered an HTTP 400 API error when auditing .SRCINFO, resulting in an inconclusive verdict. The deepseek model successfully audited all files and correctly identified the package as safe.
coverage_issues: qwen model failed to audit .SRCINFO due to an HTTP 400 API error.
learnings: Transient API errors (e.g., HTTP 400) should be handled gracefully or retried, rather than causing the entire audit to fail or return inconclusive when other models succeed.
An inconclusive verdict caused by a tool error should not override a safe verdict from another model that successfully reviewed the same files.
